comment: Key prefixes the engine reads from its bundled copy, Sources/WorldGen/Profiles/mock-values.json (R, 8 Oct 2026: the engine bundle only includes keys the engine uses; the full file stays as the reference). Tools/lookloop/compile_mocks.py writes the FULL file to Resources/look/mock-values.json for the tools and only these prefixes into the bundled copy, so the app does not ship and parse the whole 8+ MB file at load. Proposed by 5A (P0). A lane that starts reading a new prefix adds it here in the same commit; the engine's requireNumber and requireHex fail loudly on a missing key. Remove this file and the bundled copy becomes the full file again.
